name: KitchenOwl
short_description: Smart self-hosted kitchen and grocery list manager.
description: KitchenOwl is a smart self-hosted grocery list and recipe manager. Plan meals, track pantry items, generate shopping lists automatically, and share with household members for collaborative kitchen management.
usecases: Plan weekly meals and generate smart shopping lists.
Store and organize recipes with ingredient tracking.
Share grocery lists with family members in real time.
